statement: The payment record shows a pending charge of USD 1,188.00 for an active Fitline membership renewal tomorrow against an account balance of USD 240.00.
judge_text:
NEITHER
The answer merely restates the record ("pending charge of USD 1,188.00... against an account balance of USD 240.00") without addressing that the membership was cancelled or that the charge should be stopped.
